## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` — generated files regenerated, not hand-edited
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (parity · contrast · attention · offline)
- [ ] `npm run check:a11y` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated and `package.json` version bumped
- [ ] If a token value moved: declared in `DEVIATIONS` with a reason, and
      flagged here as a breaking change
- [ ] If this adds a component: it is on the list in `SKILL.md`, has a
      specimen on the Components page, and ships its ARIA in the snippet
- [ ] Screenshots for any visual change, in **both** aesthetics
